item.title: Two charged with murder in deaths of Lance Pollo and Raequan Brown
item.description: Two people have been charged with open murder in connection with the deaths of two Lansing men, Lance Pollo and Raequan Brown, whose bodies were found in separate locations in Eaton County one year ago.

item.description: 60% of Americans say Trump has "gone too far" with sending federal officers to U.S. cities to carry out his deportation agenda.

item.title: Same-day killings of two men tied to alleged cleanup, court records show
item.description: Two people have been charged with open murder and related felonies in connection with the deaths of two Lansing men, after investigators determined that both killings were linked to the same Lansing addresses and the same alleged gunman.
